title.narrative: JAILYM ‒ Multi-actor partnerships and innovation at the service of economic and environmental sustainability of grazing activities in Enbekshi-Kazakh District

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to contribute to improving the role of CSOs and LAs in tackling the effects of climate change and biodiversity loss on pastures and agriculture. The action is specifically aimed at enhancing capacities and interaction of CSOs, local authorities and farmers on sustainable Pasture Management in Enbekshi-Kazakh District of the Almaty Region in Kazakhstan.

description.narrative: Attributes and indicators of environmental sustainability and efficiency of pasture management improved in the target areas (% of vegetative mass, utilization rate of fodder mass by livestock, grazing and rotation calendars, etc.)

comment.narrative: A mix of subindicators are used to assess the environmental sustainability and efficiency of the pasture incl. the of vegetative mass the utilization rate of fodder mass by livestock grazing and rotation calendars etc.. title.narrative: 1.2 Number of delegates and composition of the institutional mechanism

description.narrative: Number of delegates involved, and composition of the districtlevel institutional mechanism called District Pasture Management Council (DPCC)

comment.narrative: the 5050 principle here could not be applied as farmers and delegates of the akimats are predominately male. However the percentage of women in the Council will be intentionally higher than the percentage of women farmers and pasture users in the target areas estimated in 15 and responds to the purpose of boosting the use of incentive measures able to stimulate a higher participation of women in Kazakh institutions currently women are significantly less represented than men in local institutions and to incentivize womens engagement in pasture management and decision making.
